_comment: Telegram message templates (HTML parse mode). Only trigger events; other event sources keep their current templates. Apply with agents/scripts/zbx_mediatype_update.py. telegram.js sends the subject as the first line followed by the message: put the header only in the subject.

message_templates.subject: {SEV.EMOJI} ZABBIX · PROBLEMA
message_templates.message: {EVENT.NAME} 🖥 Host: {HOST.NAME} · {HOST.IP} ⚠️ Severidad: {EVENT.SEVERITY} 📊 Datos: {EVENT.OPDATA} ⬆️ Depende de: {EVENT.TAGS.uplink} 🔁 Abiertos sin reconocer: {TRIGGER.EVENTS.PROBLEM.UNACK} 🕒 Inicio: {EVENT.DATE} {EVENT.TIME} 🔗 Ver problema · Datos del host
